args: set -eu; revision=$(sed -n '/^[[:space:]]*- github: ai-outfitter\/\.agents[[:space:]]*$/,/^[[:space:]]*- /{s/^[[:space:]]*ref:[[:space:]]*//p;}' /workspace/.agents/settings.yml | head -1); test -n "$revision" || { echo 'forge MCP: no pinned ai-outfitter/.agents revision in settings.yml' >&2; exit 1; }; cache_key=$(printf '%s#%s' 'git+https://github.com/ai-outfitter/.agents.git' "$revision" | base64 -w0 | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '='); catalog=/workspace/.agents-cache/repos/$cache_key; launcher=$catalog/scripts/forge-mcp-launch.js; test -f "$launcher" || { echo 'forge MCP: launcher missing from resolved catalog checkout' >&2; exit 1; }; umask 077; printf '%s\n' "$catalog" > /tmp/forge-catalog-path; exec node "$launcher" "$@"
